projects.title: Numerical Library Testing Capstone
bullets: Wrote unit tests with Python and pytest for utility functions in small open-source numerical libraries as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone.
Documented test failures and fixes for the capstone's public numerical utility libraries, using Git during the work.

research.title: Public Transit Table Queries
bullets: Loaded public transit timetable tables into a SQLite relational database using Python as part of supervised faculty research.
Wrote SQL aggregation and join queries for public transit timetable tables while assisting research on query performance.
